characters.description: The expedition commander and keeper of a spiritual realm.
characters.name: Jason Asano

characters.description: Jason Asano’s shadow familiar, scout, and practical adviser.
characters.name: Shade

characters.description: Jason Asano’s eye familiar, whose butterflies and unusual magic support reconnaissance and combat.
characters.name: Gordon

characters.description: Jason Asano’s powerful blood-based familiar and close spiritual companion.
characters.name: Colin

characters.description: An array specialist and one of Jason Asano’s closest allies.
characters.name: Farrah Hurin

characters.description: The expedition’s principal astral-magic researcher.
characters.name: Clive Standish

characters.description: Team Biscuit’s defender and field leader.
characters.name: Humphrey Geller

characters.description: A swift striker in Team Biscuit.
characters.name: Sophie Wexler

characters.description: Team Biscuit’s infiltrator and ritual specialist.
characters.name: Belinda Callahan

characters.description: A healer and member of Team Biscuit.
characters.name: Neil Devone

characters.description: A veteran defender and mentor.
characters.name: Rufus Remore

characters.description: A Leonid smith and established ally of Jason Asano.
characters.name: Gareth Xandier

characters.description: An aerial combatant and long-standing ally of Jason Asano.
characters.name: Taika

characters.description: A gold-rank mental-health specialist.
characters.name: Arabelle Remore

characters.description: A senior gold-rank ally and formidable combatant.
characters.name: Amos Pensinata

characters.description: A healer and magical researcher in Jason's wider circle. He examines unusual magical alterations and supports efforts to understand threats affecting Jason's companions.
characters.name: Carlos Quilido

characters.description: Sophie's mother, held safely within Jason's spiritual realm. Imposed faith magic has left her unstable, and her condition remains beyond an immediate cure.
characters.name: Melody Jane

characters.description: A freed silver-rank messenger who wants an identity outside both Astral King rule and its revolutionary opposition. She agrees to help Jason care for newly awakened messengers who have inherited knowledge but lack names and lived experience.
characters.name: Jali Corrik Fen

characters.description: A gold-rank former servant of an Astral King and committed advocate for the Unorthodoxy. Jason accepts his help but prevents him from recruiting newly awakened messengers before they can make informed choices.
characters.name: Marek Nior Vargas

characters.description: A freed messenger who remains attached to traditional authority and openly hostile to Jason. She declines to assist his discussion of the new messengers and competing factions.
characters.name: Tera Jun Casta

characters.description: A search-party leader focused on finding and protecting his dispersed team. He accepts a dangerous working arrangement with Marek and selected messengers after Jason explains the risks directly.
characters.name: Rick Geller

characters.description: The gold-rank commander of the Builder cult force allied with expedition members against Undeath. He helps lead survivors gathered in an open forest territory.
characters.name: Beaufort

characters.description: A gold-rank healer and high priestess. She assists Clive's examination of fallen Undeath priests and confirms that they cannot reach the divine power needed to reanimate.
characters.name: Hana Shavar

characters.description: The gold-rank commander of the displaced Brightheart force. She helps organise survivors gathered with the expedition's other allied groups.
characters.name: Marla

characters.description: Neil's defender partner. The pair preserve comatose messengers they cannot awaken properly, then move toward a storm territory where unseen factions are fighting.
characters.name: Dustin

characters.description: The leader of Undeath's priests in the transformation zone. He claims a territory and exploits the instinctive submission of the messengers released there.
characters.name: Garth

characters.description: An earth-affinity Brightheart commander caught in a three-sided conflict. He seeks cooperation with Builder cultists against the larger Undeath force while another Brightheart leader rejects the alliance.
characters.name: Durham

characters.description: A gold-rank messenger with resistance to the corrupted natural array. He arrives claiming a mission to address the great tree and treats the corrupted messenger Mark Denkala as unfit to face it.
characters.name: Boris Ket Lundi

characters.description: A humanoid rabbit of unknown identity found beside a shielded structure in storm country. Some power prevents it from speaking freely.
characters.name: Unidentified Rabbit Figure

characters.description: A rabbit-like person linked to Jason's soul realm and the Lightning Mesa. Once named, he is understood as Jason's independent living creation, with knowledge of the mesa but no clear memory of his own origin.
characters.name: Nick

characters.description: A great astral being whose prime vessel is Velius. The Reaper asks Jason to restore the sundered cosmic throne during his coming transition.
characters.name: Reaper

characters.description: A great astral being that opposes restoration of the cosmic throne because the existing pact system preserves greater freedom. It is expected to lead the attempt to break Jason's will during his transition.
characters.name: World Phoenix

characters.description: A gold-rank ally of the expedition.
characters.name: Constance

characters.description: The gold-rank tactical commander for the underground expedition. She arrives with Rick's returning coalition and helps turn its disconnected territory clusters into a coordinated alliance.
characters.name: Miriam Vance

characters.description: A corrupted gold-rank messenger still branded to Vesta Carmis Zell. He claims territories with newly awakened messengers whom he treats as expendable.
characters.name: Mark Denkala

characters.description: An Astral King whose spiritual imprint is tied to the hostile messenger group Belinda infiltrates. Her influence raises doubts about who truly controls the newly claimed messengers.
characters.name: Vesta Carmis Zell

characters.description: A quiet silver-rank messenger embedded in Belinda's group who is revealed as her ally during their escape.
characters.name: Stash

characters.description: A powerful astral figure who takes an interest in Jason Asano.
characters.name: Velius

characters.description: A powerful diamond-rank visitor whom Shade recognises from earlier dealings. She serves the Keeper of Moments as its prime vessel.
characters.name: Prime Vessel of the Keeper of Moments

characters.description: The corrupted tree controlling the final territory and contesting Jason Asano for control of the transformation zone.
characters.name: Corrupted World Tree

characters.description: The name chosen by the avatar of Jason's living tree city. Arbor is the preserved person first encountered as the Corrupted World Tree, now permanently rooted within Jason's developing astral kingdom.
characters.name: Arbor

characters.description: The great astral being that formerly possessed Thadwick Mercer. It enters Jason's constrained soul contest as a strategic supporter of restoring the Cosmic Throne.
characters.name: Builder

characters.description: Jason's niece and a prospective student for Rufus. She lives within the Asano clan's protected European domains, where her family is preparing her to use power with restraint.
characters.name: Emmy

characters.description: Jason's paternal grandmother and the Asano clan matriarch. She leads the clan's European response and receives Rufus and Taika when they reach its protected territory.
characters.name: Yumi Asano

characters.description: A displaced former member of Team Storm Shredder. Grieving the loss of her team and unable to remain at home, she accepts Sophie's offer to work with Team Biscuit while seeking a new purpose.
characters.name: Zara Noreen

characters.description: A newborn Leonid whose soul once belonged to Gareth Xandier. He is a distinct person with no memories or identity from that earlier life.
characters.name: Gary

characters.description: Neil's partner, whose unresolved feelings about the absent Jason Asano prevent their relationship from becoming secure. Neil ends the relationship until she can resolve those feelings.
characters.name: Cassandra

characters.description: A Magic Society director connected to Sophie's earlier exploitation. Humphrey and Sophie confront him for the active codes needed to open a Society archive vault.
characters.name: Poshad Finn

characters.description: A Celestine spy whose urban scouting and knowledge of criminal settings have become valuable to Team Biscuit. She accompanies Belinda during the team's travel after the archive operation.
characters.name: Estella Warnock

characters.description: Jory leads the alchemy-efficiency school within Kuzlark's medical university and is Belinda Callahan's partner. He agrees that their differing lives have brought their relationship to an end.
characters.name: Jory

characters.description: The gold-rank leader of Europe's principal surviving vampire stronghold. Her forces endure a magical-sunlight nuclear strike as open war develops between vampire lords and human powers.
characters.name: Elizabeth

characters.description: A territory holder whose accumulating claims are causing escalating instability.
characters.name: Gabriel Remore

characters.description: A councilwoman whose former territory remains a serious risk because its elemental messengers may still be bound to it.
characters.name: Councilwoman Loren
